visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a bun and wearing a black tank top stands in a bright, modern kitchen, holding a wooden stand with three seaweed hand rolls toward the camera. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the hand rolls, showing intricate details of the fillings: kimchi, clear noodles, and white creamy dressing topped with sesame seeds. (3) A top-down shot reveals the ingredients arranged on a grey counter: seaweed sheets, kimchi, clear agar-agar noodles, shiso leaves, and tubes of salad dressing. (4) Back in the kitchen, the woman gestures with a tube of salad dressing, then holds up a bowl of transparent, curly agar-agar noodles to emphasize their texture. (5) A close-up shows hands dipping the clear noodles into a glass bowl of ice water, with visible ice cubes floating on top. (6) The woman returns to the frame, holding a tube of 'Laurel' brand salad dressing near her face while smiling and talking. (7) A montage shows her assembling the hand roll: placing a green shiso leaf on seaweed, adding noodles, kimchi, and squeezing wavy lines of the white salad dressing over the top. (8) A young man in a beige shirt enters the frame; the woman feeds him a hand roll, and he reacts with dramatic, high-energy gestures, waving his hands and looking surprised. (9) The woman laughs and interacts with the man while holding the dressing tube; she then demonstrates squeezing the dressing directly into her mouth with a playful expression. (10) The final shot shows the couple smiling together, holding up two tubes of the salad dressing towards the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Ingredients -> Tutorial -> Reaction -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'Laurel' Vegan Salad Dressing by demonstrating a simple, refreshing summer recipe. The video uses high-energy editing and emotional reactions to associate the product with health, ease of use, and nostalgic family memories.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product '桂冠全素沙拉', mention of the brand name in subtitles and dialogue, and a giveaway CTA at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully merges social media trend aesthetics (fast cuts, variety text) with traditional product endorsement. The high-energy chemistry between the two subjects enhances the appeal.
